name: Hoisin Pork Stir-Fry with Soba Noodles, Broccoli, Celery & Ginger

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
6 sticks celery

instructions.primary_message: Once the water is boiling, add noodles and cook according to package directions, about 5 minutes. Once done, drain and rinse thoroughly under cold water; set aside.
While the noodles are cooking, peel and mince ginger. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and thinly slice green onions crosswise; add to the bowl with the ginger.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise; add to the bowl.
Pat pork dry with paper towels and slice crosswise into ½-inch thick strips. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, pork, garlic powder, and salt; stir-fry until the meat is browned and cooked through, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add broccoli, hoisin sauce, and water to the skillet; stir to combine and cover with a lid. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until broccoli is tender and sauce is warmed through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (510 g) bags broccoli florets
½ cup hoisin sauce
½ cup water

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide noodles, stir-fry, and sauce between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
